channel.title: Japan AI Monitor
channel.description: AI monitoring of Japan's political, economic and security developments

item.title: Peer-support program for healthier aging gains ground in Sendai
item.description: The program, focused on frailty prevention, was launched in 2015, and similar programs are now active in more than 100 municipalities across Japan.

item.title: Eisenkot gets chance to form Israeli government after vote
item.description: The ex-general has up to six weeks to try to form a coalition, failing which the task likely reverts to caretaker Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu.

item.title: Japan to launch online reporting system for nursing care accidents
item.description: The aim is to help local governments quickly identify accidents and share with the central government so it can collect more comprehensive data.

item.title: Mizuho pierces Nomura’s Japan bubble with big-ticket global IPOs
item.description: Anthropic's listing is the third in a string of blockbuster deals where Mizuho snagged a key role.

item.title: Swiss franc, Japanese yen Rise as DeepSeek News Boosts Safe Havens
item.description: The Yen and Swiss Franc were stronger against the dollar as investors sought safe havens after Chinese start-up DeepSeek’s new AI model hit U.S. tech stocks.
